# Aquapacity

> Free, science-based aquarium stocking calculator for freshwater and saltwater tanks. Supports 100+ species with bioload modeling, filter capacity analysis, nitrate stability prediction, and plant density correction.

Aquapacity is a web tool that replaces outdated rules like the "1 inch per gallon" with a species-specific bioload model derived from published scientific data on oxygen consumption and nitrogen excretion rates (Jobling 1994, Fromm 1980). It calculates how many fish a tank can safely hold based on tank volume, filter type and media, biological efficiency, water change schedule, and live plant density.

## Key Features

- 100+ freshwater and saltwater species database with individual bioload coefficients
- Filter analysis: type multipliers (canister, HOB, sump, sponge, wet/dry), 9 filter media types, biological efficiency scoring
- Dual-filter support: calculate combined flow and weighted bio-efficiency for two filters
- Nitrate steady-state model: predicts NO3 accumulation at current stocking and maintenance schedule
- Plant density bonus: low/medium/high density with CO2 injection correction
- Water change frequency and volume modelling
- Freshwater and saltwater/reef modes with species-appropriate thresholds
- Metric and imperial units
- Available in English, Spanish, and Brazilian Portuguese

## Calculator

- Main calculator (EN): https://aquapacity.com/

## The Bioload Algorithm

Aquapacity uses species-specific bioload coefficients derived from empirical analysis of 144 species (74 freshwater, 50 saltwater fish, 20 saltwater invertebrates):

- BioloadGPH = k_base × L^1.15 × metabolic_modifier
- k_FW = 0.221, k_SW = 0.156 (saltwater fish have ~29% lower metabolic rate)
- Exponent 1.15 fitted by least-squares regression on real species data
- Filter capacity C_bio = flow_GPH × biological_efficiency × water_change_penalty
- Stocking occupancy % = (effective_bioload / C_bio) × 100
- Nitrate steady-state: NO3_ss = (bioload × 15 × (days_between_changes/7)) / (net_volume_L × change_pct/100)

## Species Database

Over 100 species including: Neon Tetra, Cardinal Tetra, Betta, Guppy, Platy, Molly, Corydoras (12+ species), Angelfish, Discus, Oscar, Goldfish, Koi (pond), Clownfish, Blue Tang, Royal Gramma, various saltwater invertebrates. Full list available in calculator.
